top: In 2002, this furniture salesman was attacked outside a karaoke bar. When he woke up, he saw the world completely differently.
comment: Jason Padgett started seeing geometry everywhere and drawing complex fractals by hand. Experts linked it to an extremely rare condition: acquired savant syndrome.
topic_it: Jason Padgett, aggredito fuori da un karaoke a Tacoma nel 2002, dopo il trauma cranico inizia a vedere la matematica ovunque e disegnare frattali (sindrome del savant acquisita)
